abilities.name: poison-point
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.

abilities.name: intimidate
abilities.effect: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

original-johto.flavorText: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent's size.

hoenn.flavorText: A QWILFISH uses the pressure of water it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming to be somewhat challenging.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.

updated-johto.flavorText: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.
